Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
actually 2 questions:

may i move the derange on one of my own vampires that is not a !malkavian?
normally i'm not allowed to direct d-actions against myself.

what happens if a deranged minion play clan impersonation? can he change his
clan? is the derange still there? can he move it?

thanks

pallando

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> actually 2 questions:
>
> may i move the derange on one of my own vampires that is not a !malkavian?

Yes.

> normally i'm not allowed to direct d-actions against myself.

An action "directed against yourself" is undirected.
It doesn't matter if the action is usually directed or not.

An action is directed based on the target - it is not the directedness
that determines the scope of available targets. See the rulebook
for more on this.

> what happens if a deranged minion play clan impersonation?

He changes clan.

> can he change his
> clan? is the derange still there? can he move it?

Yes. Yes. Yes.
